# Pull Request Contract

## Purpose and scope
- Remediation / task ID:
- Base SHA:
- Head branch:
- In scope:
- Explicitly out of scope:

## Changes
- Files / areas changed:
- Business workflow impact:
- Source-of-truth / architecture impact:
- Data / schema / migration impact:
- Security / authorization impact:
- Deployment / operations impact:
- Documentation updated:

## Verification
- Commands actually run:
- Passed checks:
- Failed checks:
- Blocked / not-run checks and reason:
- Regression coverage added or updated:

## Risk and recovery
- Known risks:
- Rollback / roll-forward plan:
- Compatibility / migration notes:

## Governance checklist
- [ ] Branch was created from the current approved `main` lineage.
- [ ] `AGENTS.md`, `CONSTITUTION.md`, handbook index, and task-relevant chapters were read.
- [ ] No unrelated findings or refactors are included.
- [ ] Protected Gallery Mazhari workflows remain intact unless this PR contains explicit business approval for a semantic change.
- [ ] No secret, credential, production dump, private customer data, or runtime artifact is committed.
- [ ] Schema changes, if any, use a reviewed migration.
- [ ] Final diff and file list were inspected.
- [ ] Test results above are actual results; unrun checks are not represented as passing.
- [ ] Sensitive paths have an appropriate human review request.
- [ ] This PR is not being self-merged by an AI agent without explicit human-owner authorization.
